answer: What survives to the plume is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the tundra of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the timber re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
